0022600216.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (8-2, 1st in the Northwest, 2nd in the West, on a four-game winning streak) visit the Portland Trail Blazers (6-3, 3rd in the Northwest, 1.5 games back, 8th in the West, on a two-game losing streak) for the Thunder's 11th game of the season. Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), Jaylin Williams (back, spasms), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Thunder won their 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 124-95 win in Oklahoma City on December 31, 2025.
